title: Fractional symplectic Fourier transforms and their actions on function and distribution spaces
summary: We consider symplectic analogues of the fractional Fourier transforms and obtain convenient representations in terms of Bargmann transforms and Wigner distributions. We show that they act as homeomorphisms on Schwartz spaces, the space of square integrable functions, the space of tempered distributions, and on Fourier-invariant Gelfand-Shilov spaces and their corresponding distribution spaces.
